rationale_text: Case 10885_1000901: a 1.24 cc lesion in the peripheral zone is mildly hypointense/indeterminate on T2W (z=-0.40 relative to same-zone background tissue) with irregular, ill-defined (sphericity=0.53) margins. A substantial portion of the lesion falls outside the automated whole-gland segmentation, suggestive of extraprostatic extension (note: the gland mask is AI-derived and not verified at the capsule boundary, so this may partly reflect gland-segmentation imprecision rather than confirmed extension). These measurements are consistent with PI-RADS category 2.
